title: Problems with NS Sync.
body: Removed treatment in AAPS is not deleted in NS and causes incorrect COB / IOB on the followers.

comments.body:
AAPS is ahead of NS in functionality. invalidated records are still accounted and displayed in NS.
for nsclient just update to the same version as AAPS and you'll see everything properly
That was the mistake. It's going great again. Thank you for your great work!
